{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash -l

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./cice-qc.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=1       -> -N 1
#   --time=1:00:00  -> -t 1h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 1h --wrap "bash -l $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm -A e3sm not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.

  # NOTE: Slurm -p compute not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the compute partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=cice-qc not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --output/--error used %j expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filenames may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  # NOTE: Slurm-specific $SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR not available under Flux.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: may start in a different directory.
  cd "${PWD}"

  export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

  source /lcrc/soft/climate/e3sm-unified/load_latest_e3sm_unified_chrysalis.sh

  export HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE

  export BASE=/lcrc/group/acme/ac.dcomeau/scratch/chrys/20221218.DMPAS-JRA1p5.TL319_EC30to60E2r2.chrysalis.column-package.intel/run
  export TEST=/lcrc/group/acme/ac.dcomeau/scratch/chrys/20221218.DMPAS-JRA1p5.TL319_EC30to60E2r2.chrysalis.icepack.intel/run

  # Slurm used: srun -N 1 -n 1 python ...
  flux run -n 1 python mpas-seaice.t-test.py "$BASE" "$TEST"
fi
"
}
